newsitem.title: FRANCE: ATHLETICS-PAPADIAS UNDER INVESTIGATION BY IAAF.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PAPADIAS UNDER INVESTIGATION BY IAAF.

text.p: World indoor 60 metres champion Haralambros Papadias is among a group of Greek athletes being investigated by the International Amateur Athletic Federation ( IAAF) after their coach scuffled with a dope tester in Germany last month.
"He was in that group in Dortmund but we don't know if he was in the stadium or his hotel or another site," IAAF spokesman Giorgio Reineri said on Saturday.
German tester Klaus Wengoborski has alleged he was pushed by an angry Greek coach when he was trying to carry out random doping tests in Dortmund.
Wengoborski also said the Greek athletes left the stadium before he was able to test them.
The IAAF doping commission will report to the IAAF council at a meeting in Turin later this month, Reineri said.
The commission asked for reports from the German tester and the Greek federation after the Dortmund incident.
An IAAF source said he presumed that no action would be taken against the Greeks as they had been permitted to compete in the world indoor championships this weekend.
Reineri said Papadias, who won the world title here on Friday, had successfully passed a doping test last week.
